label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Are you ready to set out for Kitakami,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_02
text: You’ll be able to come back to Paldea whenever\nyou want, so don’t worry too much, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_03
text:
Great! We’ll set out together as a group once the
other students arrive.\c
I hear you were all chosen for this trip by lottery,
so this may be the first time you meet![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_04
text: I know my role is to chaperone you kids around,\nbut I fully intend to have some fun of my own\r\nwhile I’m at it—just so you’re aware![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_05
text: By the way...\c\nDo you know of the Scarlet Book?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_06
text: By the way...\c\nDo you know of the Violet Book?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_select_01
text: I know it

label: sdc01_0020_select_02
text: Never heard of it

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_07
text: As you should. It was the most influential book\nof the century on the subject of the paranormal.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_08
text: Really? Well, that’s unexpected. I’m quite sure\nat least one copy was donated to this school.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_09
text: The author of the [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0304)]ScarViolet Book, Heath, was in\nfact an ancestor of mine.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_10
text: I even have his original manuscript.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_11
text: Look here—these are the pages that were\nblacked out and made illegible in the published\r\nversion of the book.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_12
text: The Pokémon depicted on these pages is\ncalled [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Terapagos[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_13
text:
It’s a mysterious Pokémon that Heath allegedly
encountered when he delved even further into
the depths of Area Zero...\c
Not that the general public believed him.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_14
text: It’s my dream to find Terapagos and prove that\nHeath’s records were all true.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_15
text: Though I haven’t yet been able to secure\npermission to enter Area Zero, unfortunately...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_16
text: But that’s fine! It’ll all be fine. All I need to do\nnow is focus on the work that’s in front of me.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_student1_01
text: Ms. Briar! We’re ready to go!

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_17
text: Looks like the gang’s all here.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0020_bbteacher_18
text: All right, everyone! To the land of Kitakami![VAR 0x0114(0042)]
